description: Ausgrid - electricity distribution past outages is a dataset listed in Peclet Data Portal open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ausgrid. In response to requests for information about past interruptions to power supply, Ausgrid provides a quarterly data set for use by their customers, researchers, media and other organisations. The information records interruptions affecting 50 or more customers which last for longer than five minutes. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under Energy, Utilities. Its keywords are electricity, energy, environment, climate. The portal shows 9,210 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-peclet-com-au-portal.
